issues.description: Template Farm.java declares the helper method as `private void singFarmSongVerse(/*Animal animal*/)` (parameter commented out), while the problem statement and solution require `singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal)` to print a verse for a given animal. With the template signature, students cannot implement `singFarmSong()` as specified (iterating animals and passing each into the verse method) without first changing the template method signature.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the template signature to `private void singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal)` and update the template body TODOs to use `animal.getClass().getSimpleName()` and `animal.messageOnFeed()`.

issues.description: The feeding method is named `feedAllAnimals()` in the problem statement and solution, but the template Main.java example (commented) calls a non-existent `farm.feed()`. This can mislead students into implementing/calling the wrong API when using Main for local testing.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the template Main.java example to call `farm.feedAllAnimals()` instead of `farm.feed()` (or add a `feed()` alias in Farm that delegates to `feedAllAnimals()`).
